segments.content: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Görmedin mi Rabbin ne yaptı fil sahiplerine
translations.diyanet-isleri: Fil sahiplerine Rabbinin ne ettiğini görmedin mi
translations.clear-quran: Have you not seen ˹O Prophet˺ how your Lord dealt with the Army of the Elephant
translations.pickthall: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant

transliterations.easy: Alam tara kaifa fa'ala rabbuka bi ashaabil feel
transliterations.scholarly: Alam Tará Kayfa Fa`ala Rabbuka Bi'aşĥābi Al-Fīl
transliterations.aligned: alam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka bi-aṣḥābi l-fīli

translations.clear-quran: Did He not frustrate their scheme
translations.pickthall: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught

transliterations.easy: Alam yaj'al kai dahum fee tad leel

translations.diyanet-isleri: Onların üzerine, sert taşlar atan sürülerle kuşlar gönderdi
translations.clear-quran: For He sent against them flocks of birds
translations.pickthall: And send against them swarms of flying creatures

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Onlara balçıktan pişirilmiş sert taşlar atıyorlardı
translations.diyanet-isleri: Onların üzerine, sert taşlar atan sürülerle kuşlar gönderdi
translations.clear-quran: that pelted them with stones of baked clay
translations.pickthall: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay

transliterations.easy: Tar meehim bi hi jaaratim min sij jeel

translations.elmalili-sadelestirilmis: Derken onları, yenilmiş ekin yaprağı gibi kılıverdi
translations.diyanet-isleri: Sonunda onları, yenilmiş ekin gibi yaptı
translations.clear-quran: leaving them like chewed up straw
translations.pickthall: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)
